changes.title: Auto-hide never gets stuck
changes.detail: The Dock hides again reliably, and one click outside closes all its menus.

changes.title: Dock sized from what it draws
changes.detail: Click areas and window size follow the real Dock, so no clipping or dead space above icons (B-15).

changes.title: Taskbar style matches Windows 11
changes.detail: The Taskbar dock style uses Windows 11's real proportions.

changes.title: Pins keep Windows' order
changes.detail: Apps copied from the Windows taskbar keep their order until you reorder them in Lens.

changes.title: No freeze when applying a theme
changes.detail: Windows-side theme work runs in the background and is skipped when nothing changed.

changes.title: Twelve featured looks
changes.detail: Twelve clearly different whole looks up front; the other 77 packs are under More themes.

changes.title: Yellow, Green, Red window buttons
changes.detail: New window-button colour option; Lens panels no longer double-animate.

changes.title: Wallpaper Switcher
changes.detail: Wallpaper picker, Settings card, auto-change with crossfade, /wallpaper, voice and tray.

changes.title: No error windows at sign-in
changes.detail: Start with Windows refuses development builds and cleans up old entries (B-21).

changes.title: In-page Lens buttons
changes.detail: Optional Lens orb beside tweets, YouTube, GitHub, media, code and downloads, in the extension and Lens Browser.

changes.title: Command first Enter
changes.detail: A start-up race was fixed; a rarer case is now traced (B-12b).

changes.title: Lens Browser big update
changes.detail: Keyboard shortcuts, address suggestions, working Back/Forward, Stop, per-site zoom, Find count, new-tab page, history, downloads and per-item import.

changes.title: Simple / Advanced mode
changes.detail: Simple shows the main settings as picture cards; Advanced shows everything.

changes.title: Quick page
changes.detail: Most-used toggles, quick theme and window layouts at the top of Settings.

changes.title: Quick Settings fixes
changes.detail: Brightness for each screen, volume unmutes when raised, real Wi-Fi/Bluetooth states, Night light schedule, live window thumbnails.

changes.title: Failsafe and Safe Mode
changes.detail: Crashed windows reload themselves; repeated crashes turn that part off; a start-up crash loop brings the taskbar back and offers Safe Mode.

changes.title: Remove all, one list
changes.detail: Remove all undoes everything Lens changed, including app setups, the accent colour, workspaces and the live wallpaper.

changes.title: Smoothness check
changes.detail: Tester Hub can measure jank; one motion system for animations.

test_steps.steps: Settings › Appearance. Click through six of the twelve featured looks quickly, about one per second.
test_steps.expected: The PC stays responsive, the mouse never stalls, and the last look clicked is the one applied.

test_steps.steps: Turn on a live wallpaper, change the Windows accent from Lens and run one Lens Apps setup. Then Settings › About & Testing › Back up & restore › Remove all Lens changes, and quit Lens.
test_steps.expected: The wallpaper, accent and app setup are reverted; the report ends with 'Not changed: apps you installed'.

test_steps.steps: Settings › About & Testing › Safety net › Start in Safe Mode next time, then restart Lens.
test_steps.expected: Lens starts with optional features off and the taskbar and Dock working; the next normal start restores everything.

test_steps.steps: Turn on Start with Windows, then sign out and back in.
test_steps.expected: Lens starts normally with no white 'can't reach this page' windows.

test_steps.steps: Dock & Bar › auto-hide on. Open a Dock menu, then click the desktop, then another app.
test_steps.expected: Menus close on the first outside click and the Dock hides again within about 2 seconds.

test_steps.steps: Settings › Appearance › Wallpaper Switcher (or /wallpaper in Command). Pick a wallpaper, then set auto-change to the shortest interval.
test_steps.expected: Smooth crossfade with no black or white flash; light on CPU while a full-screen window covers the desktop.

test_steps.steps: In Lens Browser try Ctrl+T, typing part of an open tab's address, Ctrl+Plus on one site, Ctrl+F, Back/Forward and Ctrl+H.
test_steps.expected: Each works; the open tab is offered as 'switch'; zoom is remembered for that site only; Back is greyed out with nowhere to go.

test_steps.steps: Lens Browser › Import from Chrome, Edge or Arc, choosing only bookmarks.
test_steps.expected: Only bookmarks are imported, a receipt is shown, and no passwords are imported.

test_steps.steps: Top Bar › Quick Settings. Drag brightness with an external monitor attached; raise volume while muted.
test_steps.expected: Each screen changes or says 'Not supported by this monitor'; raising volume unmutes.

test_steps.steps: Open Settings, switch Simple/Advanced, and in Simple search for 'auto-hide'.
test_steps.expected: Cards show real previews; the result carries an Advanced tag and opens More options.

test_steps.steps: Turn on one in-page placement (e.g. YouTube) in the extension or Lens Browser.
test_steps.expected: A small orb appears in that place only, the page doesn't jump, and Esc closes its menu.

test_steps.steps: Tester Hub › Smoothness › Run smoothness check (about 2 minutes, hands off).
test_steps.expected: It finishes by itself with a verdict per interaction; attach the report to any jank bug.

known_issues: Command's first Enter after start-up may rarely do nothing (B-12b); press Enter again and note the time.
Agent safety isn't wired into every agent path yet (B-04); the fix is in open PR #63. Don't point the agent at untrusted pages.
Esc stops Lens at work only while a Lens window has focus (B-13); use Ctrl+Alt+Pause. Fixed in open PR #63.
The opt-in injected window-style hook isn't fully stopped by Remove all until restart (B-05, B-06). Leave it off unless testing it.
The desktop tab and edge Shelf may still briefly resize their window (B-30).

Magic menu isn't reachable from the Dock, Shelf or notifications yet (B-11); Feeds and Messages panels aren't shown yet (B-09); one-click transcription setup is blocked until download hashes are pinned (B-07).

After the November Windows update (KB5132061) some other Windhawk taskbar mods stop loading (confirmed: missing taskbar symbols). Turn the mod off and on again. Lens's own window-style mod doesn't use those symbols.
